## Summary
Build the lecture upload page with drag-and-drop file upload, Supabase Storage integration, and real-time pipeline status tracking via Supabase Realtime subscriptions.

## User story
As a faculty member, I want to drag-and-drop my lecture file (PPTX or PDF) and see real-time progress as the pipeline processes it, so that I know when my content is ready for review.

## Why this matters
Faculty adoption depends on a frictionless upload experience. If faculty cannot easily see pipeline progress, they will abandon the platform and return to manual curriculum management. Real-time status updates build trust that the system is working and reduce support requests.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Drag-and-drop upload zone accepts PPTX and PDF files (max 100MB)
- [ ] File uploaded to Supabase Storage (bucket: lecture-uploads) via TUS resumable upload
- [ ] Upload API route creates lecture record in Supabase and emits journey/lecture.uploaded
- [ ] Real-time status updates via Supabase Realtime subscription on lectures table
- [ ] Pipeline stages displayed as a progress stepper UI:
  - Uploading → Parsing → OCR → Chunking → Embedding → Extracting → Classifying → Ready for Review → Finalized
- [ ] Error states shown with actionable messages (retry button for transient failures)
- [ ] Lecture list page shows all lectures for the course with status badges
- [ ] Status polling API endpoint as fallback when Realtime is unavailable
- [ ] Realtime subscription cleaned up in useEffect return function (Data Layer Rule)
- [ ] Page component is <30 lines (Atomic Design — pages rule)
- [ ] No service/repository calls in atoms or molecules (Atomic Design)
- [ ] createBrowserClient() for Realtime subscription (Data Layer — anon key, RLS enforced)

## Canonical decisions in play

## API contract
```
POST /api/lectures/upload
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [faculty_token]
Content-Type: multipart/form-data
Request: { file: Binary, course_id: UUID, title: string }
Response: { data: { lecture_id: UUID, status: 'uploading' }, error: null }
Error: { data: null, error: { code: 'FILE_TOO_LARGE' | 'INVALID_FORMAT' | 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: string } }

GET /api/lectures/[id]/status
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [faculty_token]
Response: {
  data: {
    lecture_id: UUID,
    pipeline_status: 'pending' | 'parsing' | 'ocr' | 'chunking' | 'embedding' | 'extracting' | 'classifying' | 'awaiting_review' | 'finalized' | 'failed',
    step_progress: { current_step: number, total_steps: number },
    error: string | null
  },
  error: null
}
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// app/(faculty)/courses/[id]/lectures/page.tsx — MUST be <30 lines
import { LectureListContainer } from '@/features/lecture-ingestion'

export default function LecturesPage({ params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
  return <LectureListContainer courseId={params.id} />
}

// features/lecture-ingestion/hooks/useLectureUpload.ts
import { createBrowserClient } from '@journey/db/browser'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

export function useLectureUpload(lectureId: string | null) {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<PipelineStatus>('pending')
  const supabase = createBrowserClient()

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!lectureId) return

    const channel = supabase
      .channel(`lecture-${lectureId}`)
      .on(
        'postgres_changes',
        {
          event: 'UPDATE',
          schema: 'public',
          table: 'lectures',
          filter: `id=eq.${lectureId}`,
        },
        (payload) => {
          setStatus(payload.new.pipeline_status)
        }
      )
      .subscribe()

    // MUST clean up subscription (Data Layer Rule)
    return () => {
      supabase.removeChannel(channel)
    }
  }, [lectureId, supabase])

  return { status }
}

// app/api/lectures/upload/route.ts
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/server'
import { inngest } from '@/apps/inngest/client'

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const supabase = createServerClient()
  // ... validate, upload to Storage, create lecture record
  // Emit Inngest event to start pipeline
  await inngest.send({
    name: 'journey/lecture.uploaded',
    data: { lecture_id, faculty_id, institution_id, file_url, file_type },
  })
  return NextResponse.json({ data: { lecture_id, status: 'uploading' } })
}
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E03/E03-S11.pipeline.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'

const API_BASE = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || 'http://localhost:3000'

test.describe('E03-S11: Lecture upload UI + real-time status', () => {
  test('Upload API accepts PPTX and returns lecture_id', async ({ request }) => {
    const res = await request.post(`${API_BASE}/api/lectures/upload`, {
      multipart: {
        file: {
          name: 'test-lecture.pptx',
          mimeType: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation',
          buffer: Buffer.from('PK'), // Minimal PPTX magic bytes
        },
        course_id: 'test-course-001',
        title: 'Test Lecture Upload',
      },
    })
    if (res.ok()) {
      const { data } = await res.json()
      expect(data.lecture_id).toBeTruthy()
      expect(data.status).toBe('uploading')
    }
  })

  test('Status API returns current pipeline status', async ({ request }) => {
    const res = await request.get(
      `${API_BASE}/api/lectures/test-parse-001/status`
    )
    if (res.ok()) {
      const { data } = await res.json()
      expect(data.pipeline_status).toBeTruthy()
      expect(data.step_progress).toBeDefined()
      expect(data.step_progress.current_step).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0)
      expect(data.step_progress.total_steps).toBeGreaterThan(0)
    }
  })

  test('Upload rejects files >100MB', async ({ request }) => {
    // Create a large buffer (we won't actually send 100MB in tests)
    const res = await request.post(`${API_BASE}/api/lectures/upload`, {
      headers: { 'Content-Length': '104857601' }, // 100MB + 1 byte
      multipart: {
        file: {
          name: 'large-file.pptx',
          mimeType: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation',
          buffer: Buffer.from('PK'),
        },
        course_id: 'test-course-001',
        title: 'Too Large',
      },
    })
    // Should return 413 or validation error
    if (!res.ok()) {
      const { error } = await res.json()
      expect(error.code).toBe('FILE_TOO_LARGE')
    }
  })

  test('Upload rejects non-PPTX/PDF files', async ({ request }) => {
    const res = await request.post(`${API_BASE}/api/lectures/upload`, {
      multipart: {
        file: {
          name: 'malicious.exe',
          mimeType: 'application/octet-stream',
          buffer: Buffer.from('MZ'),
        },
        course_id: 'test-course-001',
        title: 'Bad File',
      },
    })
    if (!res.ok()) {
      const { error } = await res.json()
      expect(error.code).toBe('INVALID_FORMAT')
    }
  })

  test('Lectures page renders for faculty', async ({ page }) => {
    // Navigate to the lectures page
    await page.goto(`${API_BASE}/courses/test-course-001/lectures`)
    // Check that the page loads (may require auth setup)
    const title = await page.title()
    expect(title).toBeTruthy()
  })
})
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. Remove Realtime publication: `ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime DROP TABLE lectures;`
2. Revert lectures table columns if added
3. Remove uploaded files from Supabase Storage bucket
4. `git stash && git checkout develop`
